meta.name: swiftui-view-refactor
meta.description: Refactor and review SwiftUI view files with strong defaults for small dedicated subviews, MV-over-MVVM data flow, stable view trees, explicit dependency injection, and correct Observation usage. Use when cleaning up a SwiftUI view, splitting long bodies, removing inline actions or side effects, reducing computed `some View` helpers, or standardizing `@Observable` and view model initialization patterns.

copy.tagline: 重构 SwiftUI 视图,拆分为专注子视图并规范数据流
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在清理 SwiftUI 视图、拆分长 body 或规范 MVVM 模式
copy.tagline_en: Refactor SwiftUI views into focused subviews with clean data flow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are cleaning up SwiftUI views, splitting long bodies, or standardizing MVVM patterns

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你重构 SwiftUI 视图：把长 body 拆成专用子视图，把内联操作和副作用移到方法里，保持视图树稳定，并正确使用 @Observable 和视图模型。
howto.when: 当你要求清理 SwiftUI 视图、拆分长 body、移除内联操作或副作用、减少计算型 some View 辅助属性、或标准化 @Observable 与视图模型初始化模式时触发。

say.text: 帮我重构这个 SwiftUI 视图，把长 body 拆成子视图。
say.note: Claude 会提取专用子视图类型。

say.text: 把这个视图里的内联操作移到私有方法里。
say.note: Claude 会移除 body 中的业务逻辑。

say.text: 检查这个视图的 @Observable 用法是否正确。
say.note: Claude 会确认 Observation 使用模式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you refactor SwiftUI views: split long bodies into dedicated subviews, extract inline actions and side effects into methods, keep the view tree stable, and use @Observable and view models correctly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to clean up a SwiftUI view, split a long body, remove inline actions or side effects, reduce computed some View helpers, or standardize @Observable and view model initialization patterns.

say_en.text: Refactor this SwiftUI view, split the long body into subviews.
say_en.note: Claude will extract dedicated subview types.

say_en.text: Move inline actions in this view into private methods.
say_en.note: Claude will remove business logic from body.

say_en.text: Check the @Observable usage in this view.
